description: This file declares a Java interface named CapitalizedIncomePlatformService that provides methods related to capitalized income operations in a loan platform system. It includes methods for adding capitalized income, adjusting capitalized income, and resetting the balance for a loan, with transactional annotations indicating database transaction management.

classes.name: CapitalizedIncomePlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface defining service operations for managing capitalized income in a loan account context.

methods.name: addCapitalizedIncome
methods.description: Adds capitalized income to a loan identified by loanId, using data provided in the JsonCommand.

methods.name: capitalizedIncomeAdjustment
methods.description: Applies an adjustment to existing capitalized income for a specific transaction in a loan.

methods.name: resetBalance
methods.description: Resets the balance of capitalized income for a specific loan.
